$comment: How a run plays, for any theme. Times are real seconds. Tuned to PlateUp's solo numbers (wiki.plateupgame.com): a 100 s day growing 25 s every 3 days, a 120 s queue.
name: Standard

guests.$comment: Guests expected each day: day_1, +per_day each day, +per_card for each recipe card chosen (not the starter). They arrive evenly spread over the day.

hazards.$comment: Chance (0-1) that any guest leaves a mess round its chair as it gets up. A messy guest (a customer card, later) always does.

overtime.$comment: Once every card is taken, each card day squeezes instead, in turn: guests (one more a day), patience (every guest a level more hurried: 15% less patience each), mess (another chance per level that a guest leaves a mess). Each up to its level cap.

milestones.$comment: Days whose end gets its own title (big: the big one); a player's best at each restaurant is remembered as the last of these completed (and best_from, before the first).
